patch.role: ASCII-only case folding: restores A for identifiers that are entirely ASCII.

inputs.mask_ascii_mixed_case: ASCII source text with mixed case
inputs.expose_non_ascii: non-ASCII source text: A folds it, the ASCII-only repair does not

rationale: make_id() lowercases the source string before mapping non-identifier characters. The patch restores the case folding only for all-ASCII input; a non-ASCII string exposes the missing fold because the later character filter deletes the upper-case bytes instead of folding them.
